Privacy.tsx_Vwbc0H.defaultMessage: Step Review is built so that your code stays with you: there are no accounts, no cookies and no tracking, and reviews you open never leave your browser unless you start a collaboration session. This page explains what data Step Review handles, where, and why.

Privacy.tsx_cxQ2EY.defaultMessage: The server stores the encrypted data and hashes of the secrets that let participants in. It can see how large a session is, when it's used, and how many participants it has. A session is deleted when its owner ends it, or after 30 days without activity.

Privacy.tsx_iDEnD2.defaultMessage: When you start a session, the review is uploaded to our server so that others can join it. Before anything leaves your browser, the review, each participant's name and viewed files, and the step each participant is on are end-to-end encrypted, with a key that only the session's links hold. Browsers never send that part of a link, so we can't read any of this data.
